name: David Smooha
headline: Real Estate Investor, Sponsor and Florida Sales Associate
about:
Focused on real estate investing and syndication in South Florida, working alongside a select group of high-net-worth individuals on luxury residential and commercial transactions. Brings a principal-level perspective informed by personal ownership of multiple residential and commercial properties, emphasizing disciplined underwriting, alignment of interests, and prudent risk management.

Previously served as CEO and currently a Board Director of Business Solution Partners, working closely with owners, CEOs, and CFOs of mid-market businesses on growth strategy, capital structure, and long-term value creation, culminating in a successful private-equity transaction.

A CPA by training, with an analytical and execution-focused approach to evaluating opportunities. Also a licensed Florida real estate sales associate, enabling direct sourcing of opportunities and hands-on involvement in transaction execution when appropriate.

Tends to work best with sophisticated buyers, sellers, and investors who value judgment, discretion, and a long-term perspective.
… more

experiences.description:
•	Sponsors and co-invests in luxury residential and commercial real estate transactions
•	Structures and evaluates private real estate syndications for accredited investors
•	Leads underwriting, capital strategy, and transaction execution
•	Focuses on South Florida assets with strong long-term fundamentals

experiences.position: Real Esate Sales Associate - Luxury & Commercial
experiences.description:
•	Represents buyers and sellers in high-end residential and commercial transactions
•	Sources on- and off-market opportunities for private clients and investment partners
•	Serves as execution platform for investment and syndication activity

Provide strategic oversight and leadership support to a national technology and ERP services firm I founded and built into a leading NetSuite partner. Guide the organization’s long-term direction, working closely with private equity ownership on mergers and acquisitions, financial discipline, performance management, talent strategy, and market expansion.

Draw on deep experience in SaaS, ERP, cloud modernization, and recurring-revenue service models to support decisions around product direction, scalable infrastructure, customer profitability, and operational improvement. Offer strategic perspective shaped by my own founder-to-PE transition, including M&A preparation, value-creation planning, and organizational scaling.

Focus on risk oversight, and sustainable growth, ensuring alignment between ownership, management, and long-term value objectives.

David is responsible for setting Business Solution Partners strategic direction and ensuring that the company continually meets the ever-changing needs of its clients. In his day-to-day activities, David provides strategic planning and visioning services to clients, helps establish relationships with strategic partners and guides development of internal methodologies. He also holds certifications in NetSuite, Adaptive Insights, Microsoft Dynamics GP and Microsoft Dynamics CRM. An industry veteran, David in 1992 founded the business which specializes in software selection and implementation services. David began as the company’s primary technical specialist, then became a project manager and eventually assumed the leadership role he holds today. A 1984 graduate of Adelphi University with degrees in Accounting and Computer Science, David began his professional career at Deloitte as a CPA on the audit team and later developed the small business computer consulting practice for Deloitte’s Long Island office.

In December 2023, Viking Resources became an independent division of Business Solution Partners.  Viking Resources remains a separate business unit of Business Solution Partners and an independent NetSuite Alliance Partner providing Medical Device and Life Sciences professional services organization to Companies implementing NetSuite.

Developed and built a Computer Consulting Division in Deloitte's Long Island office. Managed ERP software implementation projects and provided guidance to Deloitte's clients on business application developments.  Performed EDP Audits for Deloite Audit clients.
Managed Audit Engagements of Public and Private Companies specializing in Distributors and Manufacturers on Long Island and Tri-State Area.
Managed Audit Engagements for Public Companies.  Founded the Computer Consulting Division within the Long Island Office of the firm.
